adapt_air_sacs.name: Air Sacs
adapt_air_sacs.system.description:
Bladders of spare air swell along the ribs; the chest becomes barrel-shaped.

Effect: the bearer doesn't breathe for Doctrine Rank in minutes. While not breathing, they are unaffected by gases, smoke, and choking.

Adaptation. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. At combat tempo it lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds; with a Sculpting long cast, until a Long Rest (divergence step 1) or for a milestone (divergence step 2).

adapt_bone_plate.name: Bone Plate
adapt_bone_plate.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 4. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The ribs grow outward and close into a solid box.

Effect: DR 2 against slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning. The plate is restrictive: −2 to Dodge.

adapt_bulging_eyes.name: Bulging Eyes
adapt_bulging_eyes.system.description:
The eyeballs bulge and spread toward the temples; the eyelids can't keep up, and the gaze becomes unblinking.

Effect: the field of vision is almost all-round: the bearer can't be targeted by Flank Attack and can't be caught off guard from behind.

Adaptation. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. At combat tempo it lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds; with a Sculpting long cast, until a Long Rest (divergence step 1) or for a milestone (divergence step 2).

adapt_claws.name: Claws
adapt_claws.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 2. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The nails blacken, lengthen, and curve; the fingers stretch out.

Effect: unarmed strikes deal damage one Ladder step higher. The bearer climbs trees and similar surfaces without a check.

adapt_darkvision.name: Cat's Eye
adapt_darkvision.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 1. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The pupil spreads across the whole iris, and the eye turns solid black.

Effect: the bearer sees in total darkness.

adapt_flexibility.name: Flexibility
adapt_flexibility.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 2. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The joints soften and the ligaments lengthen: the body bends where it shouldn't.

Effect: +2 to Dodge.

adapt_gills.name: Gills
adapt_gills.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 3. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

Slits open on the neck, their edges moving wetly.

Effect: the bearer breathes underwater. The property is binary; it has no number.

adapt_keen_senses.name: Feral Senses
adapt_keen_senses.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 1. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The nostrils flare, and the ears turn toward sound.

Effect: a situational bonus of +2…+5 to checks that rely on smell and hearing, at the GM's discretion. The system deliberately has no numerical effect: the bonus is situational.

adapt_loose_joints.name: Displaced Joints
adapt_loose_joints.system.description:
Shoulders and hips slip out of their sockets and back again without harm; moving like this hurts, but it's possible.

Effect: the bearer automatically wriggles out of grapples and bonds, no roll required. They squeeze through a gap half the width of their own shoulders.

Adaptation. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. At combat tempo it lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds; with a Sculpting long cast, until a Long Rest (divergence step 1) or for a milestone (divergence step 2).

adapt_nictitating.name: Second Eyelids
adapt_nictitating.system.description:
A second, transparent membrane grows under the eyelid and moves across the eye.

Effect: the bearer can't be blinded by a flash, sand, smoke, or splashes; they can keep their eyes open underwater and in a blizzard.

Adaptation. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. At combat tempo it lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds; with a Sculpting long cast, until a Long Rest (divergence step 1) or for a milestone (divergence step 2).

adapt_regeneration.name: Regeneration
adapt_regeneration.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 5. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The flesh closes before your eyes; the edges of the wound crawl toward each other.

Effect: the bearer regains 3 HP at the start of their turn.

adapt_reverse_knees.name: Reverse Knees
adapt_reverse_knees.system.description:
The knee snaps backward, the heel rises, and the bearer stands on their toes: the leg of a beast standing on its hind legs.

Effect: a jump needs no run-up and covers twice the distance. Rough terrain costs the bearer no extra meters of Speed.

Ordinary footwear can't be worn this way.

Adaptation. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. At combat tempo it lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds; with a Sculpting long cast, until a Long Rest (divergence step 1) or for a milestone (divergence step 2).

adapt_scales.name: Scales
adapt_scales.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 3. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The skin splits into plates that overlap one another.

Effect: DR 2 against slashing and piercing damage.

adapt_scent.name: Scent
adapt_scent.system.description:
The nasal passages grow deep into the skull; the nostrils become moist and mobile.

Effect: the bearer follows a trail by scent, recognizes acquaintances by smell, and senses the presence of the living behind a wall or in the dark. There's no numerical bonus: it's a new ability, not a bonus to a check.

Divergence step 2: a human nose can't do this; it requires beast tissue and a long cast.

Adaptation. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. At combat tempo it lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds; with a Sculpting long cast, until a Long Rest (divergence step 1) or for a milestone (divergence step 2).

adapt_thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
adapt_thick_skin.system.description:
Adaptation of rank 2. Biomancy, the Adaptation Modifier. Lasts Doctrine Rank in rounds (3 by default).

The skin coarsens and thickens, covered with horny growths.

Effect: DR 1 against slashing and piercing damage.
